in_hebrew.name: Aldrich
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Aldrich הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The Old English name Aldrich is derived from the Old English words 'ald' meaning 'old' or 'ruler' and 'ric' meaning 'power' or 'ruler'. This name was common during the Middle Ages and was borne by several Anglo-Saxon rulers. In Christian tradition, it is associated with the virtue of wisdom and the idea of ruling one's own life with integrity and wisdom.
